set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/threshold. Acceptance: introduce StatisticField/StatisticMap with StatKind and DegreesOfFreedom; split threshold alternative from evidence orientation and reject incompatible alternatives for unsigned evidence; add scoring input tying MaskedField, PriorWeights, and Region; replace score/threshold sentinels with ADTs; type correction policies and adjusted p-values; structure ThresholdResult p-value/cutoff semantics. Verification: thresholdJVM/test and thresholdJS/test plus downstream fit/group statistic map compile fallout.
set.title: Type statistic fields, scoring domains, correction policies, and threshold results
